title: Air Pollution Predictor Commons
text: goal appc package provide daily, high resolution, near real-time, model-based ambient air pollution exposure assessments. achieved training generalized random forest several geomarkers predict daily average EPA AQS concentrations 2017 near-present (currently June 2026) exact locations across contiguous United States (see vignette("cv-model-performance") details). APPC collects harmonizes EPA AQS outcomes handles model development, evaluation, prediction. geomarker package supplies environmental predictors. development version prepares model generation 3 using geomarker 0.2.0, coverage January 1, 2017 June 30, 2026. Build v3 training data model running predictions branch. published v2 model performance results belong APPC v2.0.1.

S2 models earth sphere represents locations hierarchical cells sphere. high level, earth projected onto faces cube faces recursively subdivided smaller square cells, unique ID (often represented 64-bit integer hex string).
